title: Relay as a DBFlux sibling
brief: Relay on DBFlux's Bolt structure (islands, cuts, typography, density) with its own jewel-tone accent, and strict visual hierarchy: two focal points, accent only on a few anchors, quiet method labels.

artboards.title: Cobalt
artboards.tradeoff: Calm and trustworthy, clearly not Postman; blue is the most common accent in dev tools

artboards.title: Emerald
artboards.tradeoff: Distinctive next to byzantine; green accent competes with success/GET semantics

artboards.title: Garnet
artboards.tradeoff: Closest jewel sibling to byzantine, strong family feel; red accent sits near danger
